title: ClaimEvidenceRecord
description: Schema for individual factual claims and source evidence references in the AI Agents Learning Wiki.

claim_id.description: Unique identifier for the claim (e.g., CLM-001).

statement.description: The exact factual assertion or architectural finding.

source_id.description: Source identifier corresponding to an entry in the source registry.

locator.description: Traceable location within the source (e.g., 'Section 2', 'Workflow: Routing', 'What are agents?').

exact_quote_or_paraphrase.description: Verbatim quote or faithful paraphrase supporting the assertion.

disagreement_with.description: Reference to another claim ID if this claim conflicts with or qualifies an alternative view.

disagreement_notes.description: Technical notes explaining context, terminology shifts, or scope differences.
